#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

ll ones[17];

int solve(ll value, int pos) {
    if (pos == 0) return 0;
    ll block = ones[pos];
    ll count = value / block;
    int base = count * pos;
    value %= block;
    if (value == 0) return base;
    int option1 = solve(block - value, pos - 1) + pos;
    int option2 = solve(value, pos - 1);
    return base + min(option1, option2);
}

int main() {
    ones[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i) {
        ones[i] = ones[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    ll n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << solve(n, 16) << '\n';
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

using i64 = long long;

i64 repunit(int k) {
    i64 res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) res = res * 10 + 1;
    return res;
}

int min_ops(i64 x, int k, vector<vector<int>>& memo) {
    if (k == 0) return 0;
    if (x == 0) return 0;
    if (memo[x][k] != -1) return memo[x][k];
    
    i64 block = repunit(k);
    i64 cnt = x / block;
    int base = static_cast<int>(cnt * k);
    x %= block;
    
    if (x == 0) {
        memo[x][k] = base;
        return base;
    }
    
    int opt1 = min_ops(block - x, k - 1, memo) + k;
    int opt2 = min_ops(x, k - 1, memo);
    int result = base + min(opt1, opt2);
    
    memo[x][k] = result;
    return result;
}

int main() {
    vector<vector<int>> memo(1000000, vector<int>(17, -1));
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << min_ops(n, 16, memo) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
